title: Workspace agents
summary: Learn how to build and use workspace agents in ChatGPT to automate repeatable workflows, connect tools, and streamline team operations.
body: Learn how to build and use workspace agents in ChatGPT to automate repeatable workflows, connect tools, and streamline team operations.
summaryZh: OpenAI推出了工作空间智能体（Workspace Agents），旨在帮助团队在ChatGPT中自动化重复性工作流。该功能支持连接多种工具，实现跨平台任务处理，从而简化团队运营流程。

aiReview.reasonZh: 工作空间智能体是企业级AI自动化的重要应用方向，有助于提升团队协作效率。
